from datetime import datetime, timezone
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CACHE = ROOT / '.verify-helper/cache'
PROBLEM = Path('/home/qand/.cache/online-judge-tools/library-checker-problems/data_structure/static_range_frequency')
BASELINE = '523956fbb612ed975d73d1fcac414238f8ec2d16'
FROZEN = ['data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp', 'components/oct_bit_vector.hpp', 'components/quad_bit_vector.hpp', 'components/fast_io.hpp', 'test/unit/wavelet_matrix_opt.cpp', 'test/unit/oct_bit_vector.cpp']


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


frozen = {path: sha(ROOT / path) for path in FROZEN}
document = dict(started_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), baseline=BASELINE,
    flags=['-std=gnu++23', '-O2', '-march=native', '-ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero', '-DATCODER', '-DONLINE_JUDGE'],
    compiler=subprocess.check_output(['g++', '--version'], text=True), affinity=[2], trials=9, warmup=1,
    source_sha256=frozen, candidate_sha256=sha(CACHE / 'wm_hash_candidate.hpp'), kernel_sha256=sha(CACHE / 'wm_hash_kernel.cpp'),
    hash_seed='steady_clock timestamp captured only by prepare_count', results=[], validation=[])


def save():
    (CACHE / 'wm_hash_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2) + '\n')


os.chdir(ROOT)
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {2})
save()
with open('/tmp/cp-wm-opt.lock', 'w') as lock, (CACHE / 'wm_hash_check.log').open('w') as log, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='wm-hash-') as temporary:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
    work = Path(temporary)
    before = work / 'before/data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp'
    before.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    before.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', BASELINE + ':data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp']))
    quad = work / 'before/components/quad_bit_vector.hpp'
    quad.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    quad.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', BASELINE + ':components/quad_bit_vector.hpp']))
    headers = {'before': before, 'current': ROOT / FROZEN[0], 'candidate': CACHE / 'wm_hash_candidate.hpp'}
    programs = {}
    for name, header in headers.items():
        binary = work / ('kernel-' + name)
        command = ['g++', *document['flags'], '-I', str(ROOT), '-DWM_OPT_HEADER="' + str(header) + '"', str(CACHE / 'wm_hash_kernel.cpp'), '-o', str(binary)]
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, stdout=log, stderr=log)
        programs[name] = binary
    unit_source = (ROOT / 'test/unit/wavelet_matrix_opt.cpp').read_text()
    unit_source = unit_source.replace('"data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp"', '".verify-helper/cache/wm_hash_candidate.hpp"')
    unit_source = unit_source.replace('WaveletMatrix<T> lazy(a), copy(lazy), rebuilt;', 'WaveletMatrix<T> lazy(a);\n\tlazy.prepare_count(); lazy.prepare_count();\n\tWaveletMatrix<T> copy(lazy), rebuilt;')
    unit_source = unit_source.replace('eager.emplace(a, true);', 'eager.emplace(a, true);\n\tif (eager) eager->prepare_count();')
    unit_source = unit_source.replace('rebuilt.build(b);', 'rebuilt.build(b);\n\t\trebuilt.prepare_count();')
    unit_source = unit_source.replace('rebuilt.build(a);', 'rebuilt.build(a);\n\trebuilt.prepare_count();')
    unit = CACHE / 'wm_hash_unit.cpp'
    unit.write_text(unit_source)
    document['unit_snapshot_sha256'] = sha(unit)
    for compiler, sanitizer in [('g++', False), ('clang++', True)]:
        binary = work / ('unit-' + compiler)
        flags = ['-std=gnu++23', '-I', str(ROOT), '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror']
        flags += ['-O1', '-g', '-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-sanitize-recover=all', '-fno-omit-frame-pointer'] if sanitizer else ['-O2', '-DNDEBUG']
        command = [compiler, *flags, str(unit), '-o', str(binary)]
        print(command, file=log, flush=True)
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, stdout=log, stderr=log)
        subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, stdout=log, stderr=log, env=dict(os.environ, UBSAN_OPTIONS='halt_on_error=1'))
        document['validation'].append(dict(compiler=compiler, sanitizer=sanitizer, passed=True))
        print(compiler, 'unit OK', flush=True)
    for source in sorted((PROBLEM / 'in').glob('*.in')):
        with source.open('rb') as input:
            output = subprocess.check_output([str(programs['candidate']), 'prepared', '--answers'], stdin=input)
        expected = (PROBLEM / 'out' / (source.stem + '.out')).read_bytes()
        assert output.split() == expected.split(), source.name
        document['validation'].append(dict(case=source.stem, passed=True))
    print('Official frequency 11 cases OK', flush=True)
    cases = ['random_03', 'random_04', 'random_05']
    variants = [('before', 'unprepared'), ('current', 'unprepared'), ('candidate', 'unprepared'), ('candidate', 'prepared')]
    rng = random.Random(20261019)
    for case in cases:
        source = PROBLEM / 'in' / (case + '.in')
        tokens = source.read_text().split()
        n, q = map(int, tokens[:2])
        values = sorted(set(map(int, tokens[2:2 + n])))
        row = dict(case=case, n=n, q=q, sigma=len(values), span=values[-1] - values[0], samples={}, median={}, input_sha256=sha(source))
        for name, mode in variants:
            key = name + '_' + mode
            row['samples'][key] = []
            with source.open('rb') as input:
                subprocess.check_output([str(programs[name]), mode], stdin=input)
        for trial in range(9):
            order = variants.copy()
            rng.shuffle(order)
            for name, mode in order:
                with source.open('rb') as input:
                    result = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(programs[name]), mode], stdin=input))
                row['samples'][name + '_' + mode].append(result)
        checksums = {result['checksum'] for samples in row['samples'].values() for result in samples}
        assert len(checksums) == 1
        for key, samples in row['samples'].items():
            row['median'][key] = {field: statistics.median(result[field] for result in samples) for field in ('ms', 'build_ms', 'prepare_ms', 'query_ms', 'index_bytes', 'object_bytes')}
        document['results'].append(row)
        save()
        print(case, json.dumps(row['median']), flush=True)
    assert frozen == {path: sha(ROOT / path) for path in FROZEN}
document['completed_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
document['frozen_sources_unchanged'] = True
save()

from datetime import datetime, timezone
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CACHE = ROOT / '.verify-helper/cache'
PROBLEM = Path('/home/qand/.cache/online-judge-tools/library-checker-problems/data_structure/static_range_frequency')
original = (CACHE / 'wm_hash_candidate.hpp').read_text()
variants = {'helper': original, 'inline': original.replace('\tstd::uint32_t exact_code(', '\t[[gnu::always_inline]] std::uint32_t exact_code('),
            'gated': original.replace('if (!count_index.empty()) {', 'if (values.size() > 1024 && !dense && !count_index.empty()) {')}
start = original.index('\tstd::uint32_t exact_code(')
opening = original.index('{', start)
depth = 1
end = opening + 1
while depth:
    depth += (original[end] == '{') - (original[end] == '}')
    end += 1
method = '''\tstd::uint32_t count_code(const T &x) const {
\t\tstd::size_t mask = count_index.size() - 1;
\t\tstd::size_t p = count_hash(std::uint64_t(x) ^ count_seed) & mask;
\t\twhile (auto c = count_index[p]) {
\t\t\tif (values[c - 1] == x) return c - 1;
\t\t\tp = (p + 1) & mask;
\t\t}
\t\treturn static_cast<std::uint32_t>(values.size());
\t}'''
direct = original[:start] + method + original[end:]
direct = direct.replace('\t\tstd::uint32_t c = exact_code(x);', '''\t\tstd::uint32_t c;
\t\tif constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T> && sizeof(T) <= 8)
\t\t\tc = count_index.empty() ? code(x) : count_code(x);
\t\telse c = code(x);''')
direct = direct.replace('if (c == values.size()) return 0;', 'if (c == values.size() || values[c] != x) return 0;')
direct = direct.replace('k < 0 || c == values.size() || k >= offsets', 'k < 0 || c == values.size() || values[c] != x || k >= offsets')
variants['direct'] = direct
variants['direct_gated'] = direct.replace('count_index.empty() ? code(x)', '(values.size() <= 1024 || dense || count_index.empty()) ? code(x)')
sources = {}
for name, source in variants.items():
    path = CACHE / ('wm_hash_' + name + '.hpp')
    path.write_text(source)
    sources[name] = path
sources['current'] = ROOT / 'data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp'
document = dict(started_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), flags=['-std=gnu++23', '-O2', '-march=native', '-ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero', '-DATCODER', '-DONLINE_JUDGE'],
    compiler=subprocess.check_output(['g++', '--version'], text=True), affinity=[2], trials=9, warmup=1,
    sources={name: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name, path in sources.items()}, results=[])
os.chdir(ROOT)
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {2})
with open('/tmp/cp-wm-opt.lock', 'w') as lock, (CACHE / 'wm_hash_gate.log').open('w') as log, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='wm-hash-gate-') as temporary:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
    programs = {}
    for name, source in sources.items():
        binary = Path(temporary) / name
        subprocess.run(['g++', *document['flags'], '-I', str(ROOT), '-DWM_OPT_HEADER="' + str(source) + '"', str(CACHE / 'wm_hash_kernel.cpp'), '-o', str(binary)], check=True, stdout=log, stderr=log)
        programs[name] = binary
    rng = random.Random(20261019)
    for case in ['random_03', 'random_04', 'random_05']:
        source = PROBLEM / 'in' / (case + '.in')
        modes = [(name, prepared) for name in programs for prepared in (['unprepared'] if name == 'current' else ['unprepared', 'prepared'])]
        row = dict(case=case, samples={name + '_' + mode: [] for name, mode in modes}, medians={})
        for name, mode in modes:
            with source.open('rb') as input:
                subprocess.check_output([str(programs[name]), mode], stdin=input)
        for trial in range(9):
            order = modes.copy()
            rng.shuffle(order)
            for name, mode in order:
                with source.open('rb') as input:
                    result = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(programs[name]), mode], stdin=input))
                row['samples'][name + '_' + mode].append(result)
        assert len({result['checksum'] for samples in row['samples'].values() for result in samples}) == 1
        for key, samples in row['samples'].items():
            row['medians'][key] = {field: statistics.median(result[field] for result in samples) for field in ('ms', 'build_ms', 'prepare_ms', 'query_ms', 'index_bytes', 'object_bytes')}
        document['results'].append(row)
        (CACHE / 'wm_hash_gate_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(case, {key: round(value['query_ms'], 3) for key, value in row['medians'].items()}, flush=True)
document['completed_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
(CACHE / 'wm_hash_gate_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2) + '\n')

document = dict(started_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), source_sha256=frozen,

with open('/tmp/cp-wm-opt.lock', 'w') as lock, (CACHE / 'wm_hash_finish.log').open('w') as log, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='wm-hash-finish-') as temporary:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)

    for compiler, sanitizer in [('g++', False), ('clang++', True)]:
        binary = work / ('unit-' + compiler)

        command = [compiler, *flags, str(unit), '-o', str(binary)]
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, stdout=log, stderr=log)
        subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, stdout=log, stderr=log, env=dict(os.environ, UBSAN_OPTIONS='halt_on_error=1'))

        print(compiler, 'winner unit OK', flush=True)

            flags.append('-march=native')

            subprocess.run(command, check=True, stdout=log, stderr=log)

                document['validation'].append(dict(case=source.stem, prepared=True, whole=True, passed=True))
            print('Winner whole official 11 cases OK', flush=True)
        rng = random.Random(20261019)
        variants = [('current', 'unprepared'), ('candidate', 'unprepared'), ('candidate', 'prepared')]
        for case in ['random_03', 'random_04', 'random_05']:

            for name, mode in variants:
                with source.open('rb') as input:
                    subprocess.run([str(programs[name]), mode], stdin=input, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True)
            for trial in range(9):
                order = variants.copy()
                rng.shuffle(order)
                for name, mode in order:
                    with source.open('rb') as input:
                        start = time.perf_counter()
                        subprocess.run([str(programs[name]), mode], stdin=input, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True)
                        row['samples'][name + '_' + mode].append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
            row['medians'] = {key: statistics.median(samples) for key, samples in row['samples'].items()}
            document['results'].append(row)
            print('generic' if generic else 'native', case, row['medians'], flush=True)
            (CACHE / 'wm_hash_finish_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert frozen == {path: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in frozen}
document['completed_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
document['frozen_sources_unchanged'] = True
(CACHE / 'wm_hash_finish_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2) + '\n')
